info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cross-Channel Servicing Activity Analysis API
info.description: The Cross-Channel Servicing Activity Analysis API enables businesses to analyze servicing activities across various channels. This API facilitates the aggregation and assessment of service interactions, empowering organizations to enhance customer experience and streamline operations. Typical consumers include data analysts and customer service teams who require insights into customer engagements. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can derive actionable analytics that inform strategic decisions and optimize service delivery.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new analysis for servicing activities across different channels. Use it to gather insights and improve service efficiency.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new servicing activity analysis. It requires the necessary parameters to execute the analysis successfully and return relevant results.
